pillar_reactions.evidence: Presented as 3-4 sessions a week of 30-40 minutes plus 5-15 minutes of daily mobility, with the flexibility score moving from 5 to 9 or 10. The prospect tied it straight to his own schedule: 'No, yeah, absolutely. This will be the priority, so the time will be fine... first thing in the morning will be that.' He had already volunteered the rationale himself — 'it's primal movement... building a body with the natural movement that the nature gave to us.'

The rep presented 'when you eat, what you eat, how much you eat' and said they would 'triple down'. The prospect had to stop and ask 'no just to clarify nutrition what do you mean?' and then revealed the misunderstanding: 'maybe i thought it was a new plan which i don't actually need it.' The rep corrected it — protocol not plan, no conflict with his existing dietitian — and it landed, but only after being asked twice.

Presented as over-communication with Trevor, app compliance chasing, video form review, weekly check-ins and the Skool community. The prospect asked a mechanics question about long trips: 'sometimes now when I travel, stay away in a couple of weeks, so at that time, it's just necessary to ping you guys.' Note he had pre-emptively discounted this pillar during discovery — 'in terms of being carried or followed day by day, I don't think it's the case per person' — so acceptance here is procedural rather than valued.

anchors.raw: It's a little bit more than what I was thinking about. It's not something like a figure to hear. So we can work around that for sure.
anchors.note: He arrived with a number in his head below $6,000 but never disclosed it, and the rep never asked. The gap was absorbed by a 50/50 instalment split rather than by value, so we have no read on how far below $6,000 his expectation actually sat.

anchors.raw: I started, you know, this journey with my dietitian, and now I'm back to 92 kilos
anchors.note: Already pays for a dietitian and has done for about 11 months with monthly BIA checks, plus roughly monthly physiotherapy. Established habit of buying professional health services. The rate was never asked, so the anchor cannot be sized.
